summary: One authenticated, read-only GET (2026-10-24, no retry, fresh private root, per FS-GG/.github#4818 Root decision 2) read Actions artifact 12305198394 (run 39509314882, producer 4ec6eafbbbf02264db9b0db4780c590abe0bf9cd, Rendering 0.32.3): 15,073,469 bytes, SHA-256 84647332..., 20 members (19 .nupkg + release-custody.json). The custody manifest is 361,215 bytes with SHA-256 7dbd4329546932c4c1d12767550b7b78aae85e32c81b354935b2c615b3e298c9, equal to the typed plan's custodySha256. An independent offline reader confirmed the bytes. The producer's own unchanged scripts/release-custody.py `verify` (19 archives, bound release plan 89369de0...) and `compare` for the three selected packages (FS.GG.UI.Scene, FS.GG.UI.KeyboardInput, FS.GG.UI.Scene.SvgBrowser) pass, run by current-composition-custody.py under the local runner; only then does the runner set actualProducerCustodyReadback. Key finding: the typed plan's package sha256 values are the SIGNED nuget.org bytes, while the custody archive rows are the pre-signing archives; every custody entry is identical in the published archive, which adds only the feed's .signature.p7s entry (checked by the producer's compare, and the join requires its 'signature present' outcome), so equality holds at payload-entry level and the two hashes must never be equated (the join refuses a typed hash equal to a custody row). Limits: this shows what the producer packed matches what is published for three packages; it is not installed or published-feed acceptance, the other 16 packages are verified only by the binder against custody, and the retained bytes live in a private root so the read is not reproducible without the same credentialed access. Durable product save, AT and whole #4818 remain separate. Glue controls use a stub binder deliberately (the real binder ran on the real evidence, and a reviewer re-ran the join offline), which is the one place this lane still fakes a boundary and says so. The join reads exact git blobs at the producer commit and runs its children with a closed environment.
title: Original Rendering 0.32.3 producer custody was read once and joined to the typed plan at payload level
